modules.name: Tuner
modules.description: Tune V/Oct to Semis, Cents and Ratio

modules.name: Phasor
modules.description: Generates a phase ramp based on a V/Oct signal. Include FM(PM)

modules.name: Phase Distortion
modules.description: Takes a phase as input and applies different distortion algorithms to it

modules.name: Fract
modules.description: Ratio tuner that uses fractions, with numerator and denominator knobs and CV

modules.name: Compar
modules.description: Takes two inputs, compares them within 3 decimal points of precision, and outputs booleans (0V 10V)

modules.name: Number To Bits
modules.description: Takes CV from 0V to 10V, normalizes to [0,, 127] and outputs the bits that make up that number in binary
